title: Water Main Breaks (2004-2019)
description: This is a list of all confirmed water main breaks since 2006. Water mains are located underground and bring water from a source - in Syracuse's case, Skaneateles Lake - to all of the homes and buildings in the city. When a water main breaks, buildings can lose access to water, and normally the fix requires opening up the road to replace a section of pipe. Sometimes water main breaks are reported, but the issue turns out to be something else. This dataset only shows those situations where a water main break was confirmed. This dataset was last updated on 02/24/2020. Data Dictionary: Label Definition fullDate Date of water main break location Closest address to where the water main break occurred leakClass Rated on a scale of 1-4, severity of the water main break. See here for scale: https://github.com/CityofSyracuse/OpenDataDictionaries/blob/master/Main%20Break%20Categories.pdf month Month of water main break date Date of month of water main break weekday Weekday of water main break year Year of water main break week Week of year of water main break lon Longitude of the pothole lat Latitude of the pothole TNT_Name Tomorrow’s Neighborhood Today area where water main break occurred. Dataset Contact Information: Organization: City of Syracuse Position: Data Program Manager Email: opendata@syr.gov City: Syracuse, NY
